messages:
maria-cs: FYI customer AcadiaHealth is hitting intermittent 403s for generation + rerank. Started after they rotated their SSO key. They can still fetch embeddings sometimes but gen/rerank fails. Request IDs: rID=6b2c4f9 / 6b2c50a.

maria-cs: Repro steps I have from them: curl against /v1/generate with Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>. Sometimes succeeds, sometimes returns 403 JSON like `{\"error\":{\"code\":\"insufficient_scope\",\"msg\":\"missing:generate,rerank\"}}`. They said their IdP sends scopes as a semicolon-delimited string.

jess-support: Got logs for those rIDs — seeing `entitlements: [\"embeddings\"]` in the token parse. No generate/rerank claims present. Ticket escalated to eng.

sam-engineer: Thanks — can you paste a sanitized example of the raw Authorization header (or the token.decode) and the exact HTTP request that reproduced it? Also which env (prod / us-east)?

maria-cs: prod / us-east. Example header (sanitized): `Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci... (truncated)`

maria-cs: Repro curl sample they ran:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-v1-large","input":"Summarize sales deck."}'
```

sam-engineer: OK. Quick triage: token parser in our provisioner expects scopes delimited by comma or space. If IdP uses `;` we may be trimming/splitting incorrectly and only picking up first scope. That would explain embeddings-only entitlements.

alan-eng: I pulled the token payload for rID=6b2c4f9 — `scopes: \"embeddings;generate;rerank\"` exactly as suspected. The JWT `scope` claim is a single string with semicolons. Our claim-normalizer currently does `re.split('[,\\s]+', scopes)` which ignores `;`.

alan-eng: Minimal repro locally: decode token with semicolon list -> normalizer returns `[\"embeddings;generate;rerank\"]` (no split) -> entitlement mapping grants only `embeddings`.

sam-engineer: Proposed mitigation: patch the normalizer to split on `[;,\\s]+` and deploy a hotfix to provisioner-parsing (staging -> prod). For customers blocked, we can issue a temporary support workaround: regenerate a service token via admin UI (which normalizes scopes server-side) or ask IdP team to send scopes as comma-separated.

jess-support: Can we offer an immediate workaround script for Acadia? I can offer to generate a new service token for them if they sign an AUP.

maria-cs: Acadia is asking for ETA. They have 2 prod workflows impacted (rerank on search results + generation for summaries) and it's blocking daily ops.

sam-engineer: Timeline: I can get a quick PR and patch in ~2 hours, test in staging ~30-45m, and rollout to prod with a small config change + canary in 1-2 hours after that. So ~4 hours full mitigation if nothing weird. If urgent we can do a one-off manual token regen for them now.

alan-eng: I'll write the patch and add unit tests for `;` delim and a couple odd unicode whitespace cases (NBSP). Also adding a short log line when we encounter unknown delimiters so we can surface customers impacted.

ops-bot: Deploy window requested by @sam-engineer — start: 6130573000, ETA duration ~30m. Please ack or move to on-call if blocked. :wrench:

jess-support: Acked and I informed Acadia of the proposed timeline and the manual regen option. They prefer us to patch and roll (less churn).

maria-cs: Thanks team. I'll keep the ticket updated and paste any extra logs the customer sends. If you want contact details for the customer's IdP engineer I have it on the ticket.

sam-engineer: Great — please also add the customer tenant id to the rollback/trace allowlist so we can follow requests during the canary.

maria-cs: Added tenant: acct-acadia-92 to the canary allowlist.

alan-eng: PR link (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/2745 — includes fix, tests, and short changelog. I'll request review from @sam-engineer.

sam-engineer: I'll review in 20m. Thanks. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: Customer acknowledged ETA and will standby.

jess-support: Leaving notes in ticket: root cause = IdP semicolon-delimited scopes + provisioner parser not handling `;`. Remediation plan = patch normalizer + canary roll + optional manual regen.

maria-cs: Closing loop here once prod canary succeeds. """
